correctness.rationale: For each positive length up to 22 the exact 128-bit Hamming-ball union predicate is equivalent to coverage; the pair of independent complete enumerators test every one of 8,388,606 words. They find zero covers below 22 and exactly 132 length-22 covers. Independent orbit construction verifies two orbits (44,88), 11-one balance, distinct windows, and each target multiplicity histogram (80 once, 48 twice) for all 132 solutions. This is a finite exhaustive proof with complete code and inventory.

value.rationale: This is a complete classification at a naturally studied exact optimum and an explicit construction seed for two-dimensional covering arrays (Chee et al. 2025, Example 26). It describes all valid replacements for the seed, only two symmetry types, forced Hamming balance and a fixed two-level reception-coverage histogram. Those are genuinely structural facts not implied by the known length table; no future performance improvement is claimed.
